findings.claim: The keycaps only ever show on desktop, but they get the phone's 3px outline. UI_RULES §3 asks for 4px outlines on desktop, and so does the spec ('4 px ink outlines'). Every other desktop HUD outline in this diff uses --desktop-outline: the HUD panels, PAUSE and the legend panel itself. The keycaps are the one exception.
findings.evidence: components.css adds `.ui-keycap { … border: var(--outline-default) solid var(--color-ink); … }`. In tokens.css, --outline-default is 3px and --desktop-outline is 4px. keycap-legend.ts only makes the legend visible when `desktop && firstLap`, so a keycap never renders outside desktop mode. The keycap is calc(var(--space-s6) + var(--space-s1)) = 36px tall, so the 2px under-32px tier doesn't apply either. UI_RULES §3: 'Outline: solid ink. 2px if the element is under 32px, 3px default, 4px if over 120px or on desktop.' In screenshot 1440x900/stage/hud--first-lap.png the keycap outlines are visibly thinner than the 4px outline on the legend panel around them. Reproduce: render stage hud--first-lap at 1440×900 without touch. getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.ui-keycap')).borderTopWidth returns '3px'; it should be '4px'.
findings.suggestedFix: In `.ui-keycap`, use `border: var(--desktop-outline) solid var(--color-ink);`, or add `.ui-keys .ui-keycap { border-width: var(--desktop-outline); }` in keycap-legend.css to match how hud.css handles desktop outlines.

checked.how: Compared them side by side. POS/LAP sit 32px from top-left and PAUSE is 32px from the right edge. Digits use the desktop sizes and panels have 4px outlines. The navy legend is bottom-left with cream keycaps and the ↑ key on rally-red. Labels read STEER/GAS/BRAKE/PAUSE, there is no SPACE/POWER-UP (as the spec says), and the legend stays below the centre clear zone (top ≈792 > 720).
The phone layout is unchanged: touch controls are visible, there is no legend, and phone sizes and insets are kept.

checked.target: Literals in the CSS and TS diff
checked.how: Read every added CSS rule. All values are var(--…) tokens; every var used exists in guardrails/generated/tokens.css. layout.ts derives 1224×566 from tokens.safeArea.frame × tokens.desktop.scale, with no literal breakpoint.

The diff has no opacity, rgba, filter or gradient. Radius is var(--radius-rect), and shadows use the --shadow-hud and --shadow-button tokens. The slide-in animates transform only, from its own (left) edge, with a reduced-motion override (§7).

checked.target: Text colour pairing in the legend
checked.how: Labels are cream on navy via .ui-panel--navy. The keycaps are ink on cream; the GAS glyph is a cream SVG icon on rally-red, not text, so the §2 24px text rule doesn't apply.

checked.target: Hidden behaviour of the legend layer
checked.how: Checked that `.ui-layer[hidden] { display: none }` in components.css means the hidden attribute really hides the legend, so no CSS display rule overrides it.
The diff only touches src/ui CSS/TS and tests. It adds no Three.js materials, textures or images.
